GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: bumped at the start; when questioned regarding the below market expectation performance of JIMMYINTHEJUNGLE rider Aidan Holt stated that after travelling comfortably in the running the gelding had failed to respond when pressured and was disappointing. Rider Holt added that the impost of 64kg and having its first start at the Mount Isa track, may have proved detrimental today.
Hung in at the 150 metres requiring Apprentice S Pointon to stop riding and straighten the gelding.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 2 Lengths Two Wide , held together much same to turn 2.5 Lengths Two Wide , Lost Ground in straight. (Bubble Cheeker (Near Side) FIRST TIME) # no excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 500m was momentarily eased when another runner shifted in when not fully clear.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths Ridden Along Went Forward Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear Under Pressure Turning for home Collared x 200m, # run ended 100m

Jumped only fairly then ridden up and took the lead Two Wide by a half length settling down, led out and crossed at 700m, Held Together in front & led 1.25 Lengths turning, laid out on turn then kept going in Straight # led all the way

Jumped Fast Ridden Along Went Forward Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear own terms to Straightening Up Under Pressure x 250m held a margin until the 100m, just couldn't finish off (xovnbag n/r/off) # led, gave all

Jumped ok restrained to last few rail 7 Lengths (700m), cornered for home a little closer, no real run on though (superficial lacerations to the left fore-leg, consistent with being galloped on) (Cross-over Nose Band OFF FIRST TIME, Nose Roll FIRST TIME, Tongue Control Bit OFF FIRST TIME, Tongue Tie FIRST TIME) # galloped on
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping and turned sideways resulting in the gelding settling further back than expected. Raced keenly in the middle stages. A post-race vet exam revealed superficial lacerations to the left fore-leg, consistent with being galloped on.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast Went Forward Lead early on-pace oppo Fast Pace on Took hold 3rd Outside x 600 2 Lengths , Hard Ridden 400 Weakened to the line - had no favours # speedon/heat stress
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide for the majority. Laid out approaching the home turn. A post-race vet exam revealed heat stress.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to a half length Lead on fence, Held Together in front & led same turning, narrowly Headed Straightening Up but kept battling to line. (Cross-over Nose Band ON, Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) ON, Tongue Control Bit ON) # led/battled on ok
Jumped just ok soon recovered settling down third off the fence 2 Lengths (700m), Under Pressure for home, Ridden Along faded out of it (winkers 1st time) # abrasion/spell
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Hung out round home turn. Rdr reported gelding did not feel comfortable in its action throughout. Tnr was at a loss to explain the performance but indicated gelding would now be spelled. A post-race vet exam revealed an abrasion to the right hind leg. Official trial to the satisfaction of Stewards prior to resuming racing.
